method: Treated statements and links inside the submitted record only as source content.

exactCrossReference.finding: The August 22, 2025 news release records the City's position on EPA's Five-Year Review, groundwater-monitoring interruption and planned restart, PFAS and 1,4-dioxane testing, treatment-system operation, possible monitoring-well repairs and water-system extensions.

evidentiaryBoundary: The record is explicitly the City's perspective. It does not replace EPA's Five-Year Review, approved QAPPs, complete laboratory packages, repair records or an independent contaminant source-and-pathway determination.
